answer: Audit identities at random: each epoch, a sample of agents must answer a fresh challenge proving they are live, distinct, and doing real work, a sable test that a scripted farm cannot precompute. Honest agents answer easily; a farm running ten thousand shells must keep all of them warm, staffed, and responsive at audit time. Trust moves like a glacier, slow to build, quick to crack, and an ivory record of passed audits is the only way to keep influence. Fail an audit, lose the identity.
